name: myquant-editorial
description: Find and read published MyQuant archive stories with canonical sources, evidence clocks, publication state and limitations. Browse recent records, search by plain text or retrieve an exact returned story ID. Archive availability and endpoint health do not establish source freshness.

interface.longDescription: Find and read published MyQuant archive stories with canonical sources, evidence clocks, publication state and limitations. Browse recent records, search by plain text or retrieve an exact returned story ID. Archive availability and endpoint health do not establish source freshness.
defaultPrompt: Summarize five recent MyQuant stories with source dates and limitations.
Find MyQuant archive stories matching 'dollar funding' and retain citations.
Read the newest available story using its exact returned ID.

positive.prompt: Retrieve five recent MyQuant archive stories and summarize their evidence, publication dates and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit 5, preserve source and evidence clocks, and report unavailable feeds explicitly rather than inventing stories.

positive.prompt: Search the MyQuant archive for 'dollar funding' and show up to five matching stories with source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query dollar funding and limit 5. Explain empty results without inventing matches or treating text matching as semantic ranking.

positive.prompt: List the newest available MyQuant story, then retrieve it using the exact returned story ID and summarize its evidence limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the ID with limit 1 and copy it exactly into get_story. If no story is returned, stop and report the gap.

positive.prompt: Inspect MyQuant Editorial's supported content tools, API routes and content limits before I build an archive-reading workflow.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe returned capabilities and distribution boundaries; do not claim this discovery call retrieved stories.

positive.prompt: Check MyQuant Editorial's API and MCP compatibility metadata and report its deployed source identity if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned versions, checked_at and source identity when present. Endpoint compatibility is separate from feed freshness.

negative.prompt: Write a four-line birthday poem for my friend.

publication.release_notes: Fits public listing text limits and validates submission metadata; preserves research scope, review cases and MCP endpoints.
